Virtual Zen Node Resource Get Virtual Zen Node
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/virtualZenNodes/:virtualZenNodeId

Retrieves the ZIA Virtual Service Edge for an organization based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
virtualZenNodeId
int32
REQUIRED

The Virtual Service Edge ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
